name: Warhead Junction

mechanic.title: Nuclear Warheads
mechanic.description: Nuclear Warheads spawn periodically across the battleground (first warning at 2:30, spawns at 3:00; 2 to 4 Warheads per phase, with a 2:30 cooldown after the last Warhead is collected). Heroes channel a Warhead for 2.5 seconds to pick it up (dropped upon death), granting a special ability to call down a tactical nuke anywhere on the map after a brief delay—dealing massive structure damage with bonus devastation in the direct center.

camps.name: Hellbat / Bruiser Camps (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located in the upper-mid and lower-mid areas. Hellbats breathe cone-shaped fire that shreds minion waves and reduces enemy armor.

camps.name: Goliath / Raven Siege Camps (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located in the outer top and bottom jungle paths. Features ranged Goliaths paired with a Raven that launches seeker missiles at structures.

camps.name: Swarm Host Bosses (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located in the top-center and bottom-center pits. Spawns waves of Locusts and drops toxic pods; secures massive late-game lane pressure.

strategy: Warhead Junction is the largest three-lane map in the game and includes underground sewer portals connecting top and bottom lanes for rapid cross-map flanks. Global heroes (Falstad, Dehaka, Brightwing, Stage Dive E.T.C.) and strong split-pushers or duelist bruisers dominate due to the vast distances between lanes and simultaneous Warhead spawns. Coordinate multiple Warheads on a single Keep or the Core to close out games rapidly, and keep an eye on the sewer tunnels to avoid surprise ambushes while rotating.
